scenario: Very simple personal task manager: Laravel 13, Blade/plain CSS, SQLite, no authentication, no integrations.
outcome: passed after implementation fixes and assisted plan review; desktop release gate accepted
clients: CLI discovery/design/spec; desktop foundation/implementation; CLI final independent QA; desktop release acceptance. Shared workspace state used throughout.

browser_cases: title validation error with aria-invalid=true and preserved notes

usage.note: Provider-reported receipts; one interrupted request has unknown usage, so recorded totals are a lower bound. Reasoning is included in output, never added twice. Request-duration sums overlap for parallel research and are not end-to-end elapsed time. The full run includes coding-time fixes, retries, plan amendments and a long pause; this is not a clean-run cost baseline. Successful-task numbers exclude planning and earlier failed attempts and are not a fresh-workspace benchmark.

monetary_cost_note: No monetary receipt or applicable price table was returned. No dollar estimate was invented.
findings_and_changes: Guarded generic tools were wasting coordinator tokens; hide blocked tools and add fixed environment probes.
Version research needed a six-fetch ceiling and on-demand compact artifact reads.
Prose around strict worker JSON caused failure; add one bounded tool-free format repair.
Coordinator investigations and a huge grep result inflated context; dispatch approved DAGs deterministically and bound model-visible tool results to 16 KB.
Keep all PHPUnit failure summaries and full bounded check logs with immutable attempt archives.
QA initially blocked because it had no shell; execute checks before read-only QA and supply actual verification evidence.

Generated sample needed a missing form wrapper, database lifecycle for the skeleton smoke test and a corrected redirect/session test. These required assisted review; this was not an unattended first-pass success.
limitations: Sample delete confirmation enhancement from the prototype is not wired; deletion submits directly.
No external integration or dedicated accessibility/screen-reader audit was performed.
A clean run of the final version from a fresh vague idea has not been benchmarked; do not treat development totals as expected app cost.

receipts.role_note: QA report-formatting repair; initial relay classifier missed its explicit Task role label.
